messages.text: Look, Mouse sees a cow. Listen. Cow. /k/ /aʊ/ Cow. Your turn. Cow.[TEACHER_COW_HORNS][TEACHER_LISTEN][STUDENT_TALK]
Yes, cow. A cow says moo moo. Listen. Moo moo. Your turn. Moo moo.[TEACHER_APPLAUSE][TEACHER_COW_HORNS][TEACHER_LISTEN][STUDENT_TALK]
How do I say the last sound in cow?
The last sound is /aʊ/. Cow. Now, let's look at the cow. Does the cow have the cake? Say yes or no.[TEACHER_LISTEN][STUDENT_TALK]
Maybe not. Let's keep looking, Mouse.[TEMPLATE_FINISH]
